prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.go using package solution.
Required API: func BoundedPrefixSum(values []int64, bound int64) (int64, bool); use (0,false) for failure
Behavior: Return the exact sum only when every prefix sum, including the initial zero, remains within the inclusive symmetric bound. Reject a negative bound and return the failure value on arithmetic overflow.
Visible example: With bound 3, [3,-2] succeeds with 1, while [4,-4] fails because its first prefix exceeds the bound.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
package solution
func BoundedPrefixSum(values []int64,bound int64)(int64,bool){if bound<0{return 0,false};var x int64;for _,v:=range values{if (v>0&&x>int64(^uint64(0)>>1)-v)||(v<0&&x<(-int64(^uint64(0)>>1)-1)-v){return 0,false};x+=v;if x>bound||x < -bound{return 0,false}};return x,true}
